notes.title: Bug Fix 3.11.25
notes.content:
Hey everyone! A player pointed out a bug with Eva's outfit not displaying correctly. I've done my best to address it, please feel free to let me know in the comments if anything else looks wonky.

Bug Fixes:
- Eva's green outfit should now display when appropriate
- Emrys' arm in his overshirt+undershirt outfit should now display correctly
- minor fixes and improvements to code

Hope everyone is enjoying the new sprites!

notes.title: All Sprite Art is Updated + Preview for Bobbi's Route!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Wrenna, Royan, and I have been hard at work to bring you more Keepers content. There's a part 2 coming soon but I wanted to share what we have so far.

Build 1.1 Changes:
- All 11 sprites have gotten a glow-up! 
- Sneak peek for Bobbi's route is coded in!
- The conversion between Emrys and Eva if she convince him to stay at the Sanctum while Mystia is away has been greatly enhance. It allows Eva time to process recent events. (Emrys' Route) 
- Choices for Emrys now track affection points! Have too few, and things may go sour when the Eva and Em are alone at the hot springs (Emrys' Route)
- 1 new Bobbi CG! (Common Route)
- The content warnings for the game have been adjusted to reflect concerns from a review; I also set some of the more spoiler-y achievements to hidden
- Minor bug fix

Regarding the sprite art: Royan and I heard your feedback about things looking uneven and a little AI-like and we feel confident we've addressed your concerns. The consistency has been greatly approved; everyone now matches the grittier aspects of the story. Royan has also made sure to include more visible brushstrokes and enhanced some facial features to be more expressive. He also has had time to redo some of the things I sloppily pieced together to save time - namely the outfit changes for Emrys and Jensen. Big thank you to Royan!

Here are some screenshots of the new cast:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238882/25e94149d5fa439c50d8e62f0054e08c58c9de3c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238882/ee7900fa7793dd6ed5fb53286b2129559c28bb7c.png[/img]

With Bobbi's route, I still hope to release the full version within the next few weeks! We had some delays but I was able to get the first couple of chapters into this update. There is now a big choice about a third of the way through the story - whether to go to Astraela with Emrys or stay on Earth with Bobbi!

Here's the new CG of Bobbi we've added in:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238882/39b2c5a2edf9cfd96ae88f5abf9de3d37afe4bdf.png[/img]

Another big thank you to everyone who has wishlisted, purchased, and/or reviewed the game. It means a lot, and it helps me to improve upon and add more content. And I've heard the request the publish an official walkthrough for the game - I am happy to oblige and will have it out shortly!

notes.title: SFX Bug Fix 10/1/24
notes.content: Back with another bug report from Jazmina, thank you again! Three of the sfx were not properly logged into the code. If any one of them was encountered, it broke the game. It's fixed now!

notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you to everyone who has purchased the game so far - especially those of you who have left a review, it helps immensely. Jazmina pointed out that the achievements aren't working - this update should hopefully fix it. I have tested it on my personal computer and will have a friend test shortly.

notes.title: Kali Update + Blinking Sprites!
notes.content:
I hope everyone had a good holiday season! After spending lots of time with family, I've eased back into game development with a relatively simple update. Minor sprite animation has been in the works for some time now, and I hope you guys are as excited as I am to watch the Keepers characters eyes open and shut and open and shut...

All of Kali's expressions are now in! The player also now has the opportunity to stay at chat with her a little longer instead of Eva making a break for her next cup of coffee. Look at her, spilling to Eva about her family drama:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238882/ef8dca5beb83f62c1f7355538a0b2b72ce138e43.png[/img]

Full list of changes:

[list]
[*] added and tested Kali's expressions
[*] added new dialogue with Kali before the DnD campaign starts
[*] all characters now blink!
[/list]

Next on the list is to make an exclusive extended demo for content creators and [url=https://ko-fi.com/gsestudios]Ko-fi monthly supporters[/url]! You can also read detailed monthly updates on game development there.

notes.title: Bobbi Expressions Update, Kickstarter is Ongoing!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, exciting news! ALL of Bobbi's expressions are now in the demo! We're also added an extended version of the scene where the player can ask Bobbi to spend the night after the break-in. Nothing steamy goes down, but you will have to set Bobbi's setting to 'Romance' in the Preferences screen in order to see it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44238882/c399d5ebbc35b43c31c6b6d95e865001ec5d4c5f.png[/img]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/329033002/keepers-of-astraela]The Kickstarter [/url]is coming along, though we need a bit more support to see it through. To help out, some friends and family of mine have offered to match every pledge we get until end of day tomorrow, 10/20. Let's see if we can boost the campaign closer to the halfway mark!

Full list of changes:

[list]
[*] added and tested Bobbi's expressions
[*] minor transition fixes
[*] Jensen now winks on his walk with Eva to the library
[*] extended the Bobbi sleepover scene after the break-in if Bobbi is set to Romance
[*] added night version of Eva's living room background
[*] added Fromir woods background
[*] added a white haze when Eva is dreaming/daydreaming
[*] added Elysian Lily background
[*] Next up, we have a Kali update in the works with her expressions, and an extended version of an excerpt from Eva's book where Thana and Emrys share a moment of bonding next to a campfire!
[/list]

notes.title: Jensen Update and Kickstarter Launch!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! BIG THANKS to everyone who's downloaded the game so far and tried it out! I would love to hear what you think of the demo - there's a link to a survey in-game.

Our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/329033002/keepers-of-astraela]Kickstarter launched[/url] a few days ago!! It would help us with game development tremendously if we could get the game funded now. If you're not able to pledge, there's a social media community goals section! Also, wishlisting on Steam is super helpful.

[b]And now for the update:[/b]

Jensen's sprite got a little upgrade, and all of his expressions are in!! There's a new minor choice at the end of the squirrel scene as well.

[b]Other changes:
[/b]
- improved the reddish pain overlay effect

- changed Ebony Brew to Ambrosia Brew

- changed Jensen eye color reference from "cerulean" to "hazel" in opening library scene

- changed library description during walk with Jensen

- adjusted one of the squirrel scene bgs

- adjusted text in chapter 5 to fix font errors

- fixed bug in bobbi kitchen scene if player had choose to flee from the dreadfiend park fight

-relegated a reference to Bobbi teasing Eva at D&D in the bar scene to Emrys:Romance

- Fixed a typo when Eva was reading an excerpt from her book in the library "strange" - "strangle"
